# ccx

> A CLI and Python library for persistent local Claude Code and Codex workers, using your own accounts. Install with `uv tool install ccx-native`. The command is `ccx`.

Every CLI command documents itself: run `ccx help` and `ccx help COMMAND`. Agents can install the skill with `ccx skills install`.

## Guides

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, first worker, follow-ups, waiting, reading replies
- [Concepts](docs/concepts.md): workers, engines, states, talking to a worker, engine differences
- [Codex workers](docs/codex.md): what differs for Codex, the shared daemon, Codex as orchestrator
- [Permissions](docs/permissions.md): full and restricted modes, approvals, questions, MCP forms
- [Usage and caps](docs/usage.md): reading plan usage, per-turn caps
- [Controllers](docs/controllers.md): Python scripts that drive several workers and survive interruption
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): exit codes, lost messages, stuck workers, upgrades

## Reference

- [Python API](docs/python/README.md): clients, results, waiting, errors

- [Engine clients](docs/python/engines.md): Claude-only and Codex-only extras
- [JSON protocol](docs/rpc/README.md): requests, responses, safe retries, errors, persistent mode
- [RPC operations](docs/rpc/operations.md): every operation and its parameters
